artifact_review: The Router identified structural irregularities in the front wheel spokes (severity 2.5) and smeared reflections (severity 1.5). I agree with these assessments. The 'structural_collapse' is the most significant defect; AI-generated alloy wheels often fail to maintain perfect radial symmetry or crisp mechanical edges, resulting in the 'melting' look described. The 'texture_anomaly' regarding the chrome reflections is also valid—the reflections lack the sharp, high-frequency environmental mapping of real polished metal, appearing more like a smooth gradient paint. The Perceptual Quality Auditor missed these because they are structural/semantic artifacts, not just noise/blur. The Topology Auditor's high confidence score is misleading here, as it confirms the wheel is a single object but does not validate the internal geometric correctness of the spokes.
alignment_reasoning: The image strongly aligns with the 'car wheel' class. All testable geometric and material checkpoints passed. The failure to verify bolt holes and tread is due to image constraints, not generation failure. The overall structure is recognizable and physically plausible despite minor symmetrical imperfections.
artifact_reasoning: The primary artifact is the slight asymmetry and soft definition of the front wheel spokes (structural_collapse, sev 2.5), a common AI weakness with complex mechanical radial patterns. Secondary artifacts include smeared chrome reflections (texture_anomaly, sev 1.5) and minor body line warping (perspective_distortion, sev 1.0). These defects prevent a perfect score but do not constitute catastrophic failure. The image is significantly better than the 'mid' reference (altar) but lacks the pristine mechanical precision of the 'high' reference (rifle).
